paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (computed as 2.7 x KSVZ coupling at the given masses, as stated in the paper)
notes: CAPP-PACE haloscope with flux-driven JPA, axion mass range 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.2704-2.3000 GHz). Paper states exclusion at 2.7x KSVZ coupling level assuming rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and 100% axion dark matter, at 90% CL. No numerical table of limit values provided; data points derived from the stated '2.7-fold above KSVZ' sensitivity using g_KSVZ = (alpha/2pi f_a)*1.92 with m_a*f_a = 5.7e-3 GeV^2, giving ~1.0e-14 GeV^-1 across the band.
